proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Lean *defines* `c5Decomposition q := −hoefsmitBSq q − 1/2` and proves it equals −3/2 + 1/[2]²; nothing links it to the precision-ladder c₅ (claimed value taken as a definition; the Lean docstring itself says "conjectured"). Algebra checked by hand: b² = ([2]²−1)/[2]² ✓, b²(1+√2) = 7/8 ✓, c₅(silver) = −11/8 ✓, c₅(1) = −5/4 ✓. Proof: Step 1 calls the bar involution an *anti*-automorphism (it is a ring automorphism: bar(T_xT_y) = bar(T_x)bar(T_y)); Step 2 "each averaged crossing contributes h/2 = 1/2" sets h = 1 with no reason (h = 1 only at q = φ; at q₀ ≈ 1.11, h ≈ 0.21); Steps 3–4 assert the trace expansion and the c₄, c₆, c₇ closed forms without derivation. c₅ is an extracted ladder coefficient, so equating it to a closed form is an empirical identification inside a proposition; it should be a conjecture
